about.title: Teaching Arabic the way it's actually spoken and examined
about.missionText: We believe learning Arabic should feel achievable and relevant — whether your goal is holding a real conversation or excelling in your IGCSE or UAE curriculum Arabic. We pair every student with instructors who teach with structure, warmth, and accountability.
about.methodologyText: Live, interactive classes over pre-recorded content. Every lesson plan is built around your specific goal, level, or school curriculum — not a one-size-fits-all textbook.
about.whyOnlineText: Online lets us match you with the best-fit instructor regardless of geography, keep class sizes small, and offer flexible scheduling across time zones — without sacrificing the accountability of live teaching.
about.diff1Desc: Purpose-built programs for conversational learners, IGCSE students, and UAE-curriculum students — not one generic program stretched to fit all.
about.diff2Desc: Every instructor is a native or near-native Arabic speaker with formal teaching experience.
about.diff3Desc: Classes scheduled around Canada and UAE time zones, with make-up class options.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.sub: Answers to common questions about our programs, scheduling, and class format.

items.q: Do you teach religious studies or Qur'anic Arabic?
items.a: No. Our Conversational Arabic program focuses purely on spoken, everyday Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha). This is not a religious studies program.

items.q: Which Arabic do you teach in the Conversational program?
items.a: Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha) only. It is understood across the whole Arab world and gives the strongest foundation for speaking, reading, and writing.

items.q: Who is the IGCSE Arabic program for?
items.a: It is designed for Arab students following the IG curriculum. It is not an Arabic-as-a-foreign-language course.

items.q: Do you support the UAE national curriculum?
items.a: Yes. Our UAE Curriculum program supports students in UAE schools with Arabic, aligned to the Ministry of Education curriculum.

items.q: What time zones do you teach in?
items.a: Our instructors schedule classes across EST/PST (Canada) and GST (UAE), with flexible slots to accommodate both regions.

items.q: Do I need any prior Arabic knowledge to start?
items.a: Not for the Conversational program — we offer beginner levels. The IGCSE and UAE Curriculum programs are for students who already speak Arabic and follow those curricula.
Both options are available for the Conversational program. IGCSE and UAE Curriculum tutoring is primarily one-on-one to align closely with each student's syllabus and pace.

items.q: How do I book a free trial class?
items.a: Use the "Book a Free Trial Class" button anywhere on the site to fill out a short form — we'll follow up to confirm your time.

items.q: How do I join my class after booking?
items.a: Once your time is confirmed, we send a private video-class link by WhatsApp and email, plus a reminder before class. Just click the link at class time — no account or app installation required.
